diagnostics.title: SetFlag without matching WaitFlag
diagnostics.message: SetFlag<MTE1_M>(EVENT_ID0) is never consumed: no WaitFlag<MTE1_M>(EVENT_ID0) exists in 'nvfp4_pipeline_b'
diagnostics.remediation: Add AscendC::WaitFlag<AscendC::HardEvent::MTE1_M>(EVENT_ID0); on PIPE_M before the instruction that consumes the data, or delete this SetFlag. An unconsumed flag leaks a hardware event slot and will eventually stall the pipeline.
